headline: Ukraine's Naftogaz Reports Over 800 Russian Attacks Since 2022
summary: Ukrainian state energy company Naftogaz announced it has sustained more than 800 Russian strikes since February 2022, forcing the nation to increase natural gas imports.
why: Naftogaz is Ukraine's primary gas production and distribution company, and physical damage to energy infrastructure dictates European regional energy trade and aid demands.

impacts.name: Naftogaz
impacts.why: Repeated physical damage reduces domestic production capability and raises import dependency.
